metadata.title: Common Shade Module F — Nepal
metadata.method: Targeted primary-source review in English/Nepali, selected report/legal sections and original study methods; not an exhaustive systematic review.
metadata.no_endorsement: No organisations ranked; listing does not imply endorsement or partnership.
metadata.city_selection: Eight documented Terai heat-concern cities; a comparable national exposure ranking was not verified.
metadata.schema_note: Evidence labels describe kind, not quality. Inference/proposed roles separate from published statements. University/NGO functional institution tags do not grant legal authority.
metadata.cost_rule: NPR/USD, installed/running/upkeep cost/year/FX left null where unverified; no universal unit price.
retrieval_limits: Current national2026 full plan/adoption and AA framework not retrieved; government listing plus attributed synthesis used.
IFRC sEAP full file unsupported content-type and direct transfer403; numbers/approval excluded, discovery lead only.
DHM annual reports intermittently inaccessible; official2024 post-monsoon report used.
NRCS Dhangadhi fact sheets404; public plan and technical-partner release used.
BEEN130-page manual exceeded retrieval limit; donor/implementer summaries used.
Health facility study concerns broad disaster readiness, not verified heat-specific facility performance.
Official heat-specific occupational standard metadata retrieved; full schedule inaccessible and numerical limits excluded.

country.name: Nepal

climate.text: Terai lowland heat includes seasonally drier pre-monsoon exposure and humid monsoon conditions. Climate suitability must be assessed at the actual place, season and task.
climate.result_basis: Climate interpretation grounded in source descriptions; not a citywide humidity series.

trends.text: National synthesis describes intensifying heat concern in the Terai and increasing exposure elsewhere. DHM2024 post-monsoon report documents above-normal southern minimum temperatures; this seasonal observation is not a long-term trend estimate.
trends.result_basis: Published statement; see source review limits

night_heat.text: Dhangadhi plan describes reduced night-time recovery in monsoon months. Comparable occupied-bedroom night records across all eight cities not verified.
night_heat.result_basis: Published statement; see source review limits

heat_context.measurement_caution: Keep dry-bulb air temperature, Heat Index, WBGT, land-surface and occupied-room temperature separate. No national exposure rank assigned.

official_heat_plans.text: NDRRMA2024 plan sets responsible/supporting agencies for warnings, water, health, schools, electricity and workplaces.
official_heat_plans.result_basis: Published statement; see source review limits

official_heat_plans.text: An additional preparedness/early-action/rapid-response heat plan is catalogued as2025 and references BS2082; selected Nepali text reviewed, with extraction limits.
official_heat_plans.result_basis: Published statement; see source review limits

official_heat_plans.text: Government Bara office lists a heat-and-drought preparedness/early-action/rapid-response plan BS2083. CEEW/GHHIN describes the2026 national plan and anticipatory-action framework. Current full national text, signed adoption decision, annexes and finance rules not fully retrieved.
official_heat_plans.result_basis: Official publication listing plus attributed synthesis; not a full current legal appraisal.

official_heat_plans.text: Nepalgunj2023 and Dhangadhi2025 HAPs are published. Biratnagar/Siddharthanagar planning is reported by NRCS, but final municipal texts and appropriation decisions not retrieved.
official_heat_plans.result_basis: Published statement; see source review limits

legal_basis.text: DRRM Act2017 expressly includes heat wave under natural disaster and establishes multilevel disaster arrangements and funds. A published HAP does not by itself establish a new offence, entitlement or budget release.
legal_basis.result_basis: Published statement; see source review limits

documented.text: DHM provides heat monitoring/bulletins; municipalities and humanitarian partners connect forecasts with local action. RIMES/DHM held a national heat impact-based forecasting demonstration workshop inJuly2026.
documented.result_basis: Published statement; see source review limits

channels.text: RAIN reports FCHV visits, radio and public announcements in Bajika/Maithili; municipal/Red Cross arrangements include non-smartphone communication.
channels.result_basis: Published statement; see source review limits

thresholds.text: Dhangadhi HAP proposes daily maximum Heat Index40.1°C for two consecutive days or41.6°C for one or more days, derived from1979–2023 ERA5 weather analysis. Mortality gaps/low variance prevented local epidemiological modelling. Confirm version/metric/forecast product and authorisation before operation.
thresholds.result_basis: Proposed climatological planning trigger using reanalysis; not validated physiological or mortality threshold.

warnings.cash_trigger: No universal nationwide heat-triggered social-protection or insurance payout entitlement verified.
warnings.limits: National percentile bulletin, local Heat Index proposal and a funding protocol are distinct triggers. No live alert or universally safe temperature supplied.

law.text: Labour Act2017 sections68–69 require workplace safety/health policy and employer protections; sections75–77 address reporting and immediate danger procedures. Primary English translation reviewed, not a current legal opinion.
law.result_basis: Published statement; see source review limits

heat_directions.text: NDRRMA2024 action plan directs factories/workshops to provide protective conditions including ventilation, water and rest. Health-insurance wording is a planning direction, not evidence of parametric payout coverage.
heat_directions.result_basis: Published statement; see source review limits

heat_specific_standard.text: Department of Labour and Occupational Safety officially lists the workplace maximum heat-level standard BS2082. Existence verified; full technical schedule, measurement conditions and current legal implementation details not independently appraised.
heat_specific_standard.result_basis: Published statement; see source review limits

occupational_heat_rules.numeric_wbgt_limit_verification: Numerical schedule not verified from primary text; standard existence is verified. Do not infer absence of heat rules or import foreign-country thresholds.
occupational_heat_rules.paid_rest_and_coverage: Heat-specific paid-rest entitlement, self-employed coverage, enforcement and current technical schedules require verification.

worker_evidence.text: Original cross-sectional study documents outdoor-worker heat awareness, practices and perceived risks. It is not a measured productivity-loss or clinical intervention study.
worker_evidence.result_basis: Published statement; see source review limits

cooling_building_policy.text: EU BEEN project and consortium promote climate-responsive design, retrofits, skills and municipal policy. Listed project period endedJanuary2026; current extension and municipality-specific enforceable by-laws not verified.
cooling_building_policy.result_basis: Published statement; see source review limits

cooling_building_policy.text: Nepal is listed in the Global Cooling Pledge. Publication of a current national cooling plan or equivalent and binding thermal-performance requirements not verified in this review.
cooling_building_policy.result_basis: Published statement; see source review limits

cooling_building_policy.text: UNEP treaty register lists Nepal Kigali ratification6August2025. Verify appliance efficiency, refrigerant safety, technician competency and lifecycle management separately.
cooling_building_policy.result_basis: Published statement; see source review limits

finance_mechanisms.name: Public disaster-management funds and municipal sector budgets
finance_mechanisms.access: Via authorised public counterpart and applicable fund/budget rules; no open NGO entitlement.
finance_mechanisms.limits: Act sections22–23 establish funds. Central fund excludes regular administration; do not assume it pays all permanent core/maintenance costs. Actual local heat allocations/releases not verified.

finance_mechanisms.name: IFRC-DREF heat anticipatory action
finance_mechanisms.access: Through NRCS/IFRC approved processes; no direct Common Shade application route verified.
finance_mechanisms.limits: Programme account identifies DREF. sEAP2025NP02 full file inaccessible; exact approval, budget, activation and payment records excluded from verified fields.

finance_mechanisms.name: RAIN
finance_mechanisms.access: Contribute through existing programme/municipal relationships subject to agreement; not an open call.
finance_mechanisms.limits: Implementation status verified. Programme aims on shock-responsive protection do not prove heat cash transfers were paid.

finance_mechanisms.name: ZCRA-backed heat and education work
finance_mechanisms.access: Existing member/implementer relationships; no unsolicited grant route established.
finance_mechanisms.limits: Do not label alliance a directly accessible pooled fund or equate project activity with evaluated health impact.

finance_mechanisms.name: BEEN
finance_mechanisms.instrument: Historical EU project funding and technical assistance
finance_mechanisms.access: Historical project/consortium learning; extension and current finance products not verified.
finance_mechanisms.limits: Finance-product targets are not a verified available loan. Do not prescribe debt for non-revenue public protection.
